left.raw_text: - Must have a clinical diagnosis of solid tumor cancer

right.raw_text: and be seeking treatment and supportive care at the UF Health Cancer Center (Medical Plaza)
- Patients must plan to receive chemotherapy known to be associated with the need for supportive care within 30 days of enrollment

left.raw_text: - Life expectancy must be greater than 6 months
- Must have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2
- Written informed consent obtained from the patient

right.raw_text: - The ability for the patient to comply with all the study-related procedures.
